description: the generate step's declarative args field: its entries append after the pinned gen argument shape, placeholder-expanded, so a gen flag reaches the processor without a declared command. The committed handler-effect schema names a handler its own crate does not install, so generation fails closed without the flag (the refusal the handler oracle pins as KDLITH-DLC006); admitted through args, --handler copy-fields lets the schema generate its crate into the scenario tree, and the passing generate step proves the flag arrived — a dropped or misspelled args entry fails the step's exit check
